description: This file defines the class NotesImportTask, which handles importing notes from a remote API into the local repository within an Android app. It manages fetching note IDs, retrieving individual notes, and updating import status with logging and callbacks.

classes.name: NotesImportTask
classes.description: A class responsible for importing notes from a remote API, updating status, and handling errors during the process.

methods.name: NotesImportTask
methods.description: Constructor initializing the import task with necessary dependencies and configurations.

methods.name: importNotes
methods.description: Starts the import process, fetching note IDs and individual notes asynchronously, and reports progress via LiveData and a callback.
